description: Single-instance RFQ quote, assignment, obligation, and fill dashboard. Native Grafana Dashboard Schema v2 delivery; Prometheus queries are scoped by namespace, kubernetes_pod, job, and instance. Requires vault-solver metrics commit d5f5385e or a descendant.

spec.title: Decision counts
spec.description: Selected-range business outcomes without transport failures.

spec.title: Quoted token amounts
spec.description: Input/output atomic units are tabular because token decimals differ.

spec.title: Obligation ages
spec.description: Comparable obligation and backend freshness ages.

spec.title: Order-poll outcomes
spec.description: Complete, degraded, skipped, and failed backend polls.

spec.title: Fill transaction outcomes
spec.description: Exact terminal txmanager outcomes over the selected range.

spec.title: Successful fill amounts
spec.description: Receipt-confirmed token amounts; planned surplus is not realized PnL.

spec.title: Execution cost
spec.description: Receipt-backed transaction count, gas, and native fee over the selected range.
